description: The pages of the main window, of the task windows and of the wiki windows may run operations of the catalog through `op`, receive change events through `subscribe`, signal their first screen, check spelling in the editor, attach files the person chooses or drops (the page names the task, never a path), open or save a copy of an attached file through the system, save an export of the list or a picture of the Gantt chart where the person chooses, export to an archive and import one that the person chooses in the native file chooser (the page names projects and a token, never a path), choose the backup folder in the native folder chooser, open a web or mail address in the desktop's browser or mail program, receive in the main window the tasks of links handed to the running app, open a task or a wiki page in its own window, read and change the app's own settings (background mode, notifications and safe rendering) and the person's time zone, switch starting with the system on and off, restart the app so that safe rendering applies, list the time zones to choose from, and keep the page's own preferences for the next start, show the quick-add window, read and change the desktop-wide quick-add shortcut, see where the command-line tool is and link the bundled one into the person's own programs folder (the page names no path), quit the app (also in background mode), set their title, and move, minimize, maximize and close their own window, for the header bar. Nothing else of Tauri's API is reachable from the page.
